title: Bonsai: Janestreet's UI Library
summary: Bonsai is a user interface library developed by Jane Street, written in OCaml, designed for building reactive and type-safe web applications. It uses incremental computation and a composable component model similar to React but leveraging OCaml's strong type system for guaranteed correctness.
problem_solved: Enables building complex, interactive UIs with strong type safety guarantees that eliminate entire classes of runtime errors common in JavaScript UI frameworks.
why_valuable: Combines the composability of modern UI frameworks with OCaml's powerful type system, making it impossible to write many categories of buggy code while being battle-tested in production at Jane Street.
